standard_prerequisites.name: Existence of a valuation ring dominating a local subring of a field

core_obligations: (2) implies (1): a DVR containing A and B maps surjectively onto K, so A  tensor  B -> K is surjective (proof lines 7345-7354).

(1) implies (2): if A  tensor  B -> K is not surjective its image C is a subring of K that is not a field, hence has a nonzero maximal ideal m; choose a valuation ring O  inside  K dominating C_m; Krull-Akizuki applied to A  inside  O makes O Noetherian, hence a DVR (valuation-ring-Noetherian-discrete) (proof lines 7345-7354).
proof_roadmap: Trivial direction first; for the converse dominate the non-field image by a valuation ring and make it Noetherian with Krull-Akizuki.
difficulty_reason: One direction is clear; the other builds a valuation ring of K dominating the local ring C_m of the image C of A  tensor  B -> K at a nonzero maximal ideal, and then runs Krull-Akizuki to get Noetherianity, hence a DVR. H2: the argument is a short chain of named algebra lemmas with the choice of the dominating valuation ring as the only non-mechanical step.
